column3: The wish is that my ways would be established.
The recounting is expressed as completed.
The rejoicing is expressed as completed.
The soul is crushed with longing.
The rebuking is expressed as completed.
The rulers sat and spoke together against me; slander is not explicitly named.
The counselors are called men of my counsel.
The path of falsehood is removed from me, rather than me from the path.
The chosen way is called faithfulness.
